items.question: Can extensive mantra recitation bring success to one who harms beings?
premises: A mantra may be recited a hundred lakhs of times.
The reciter in question has committed harm against a being.
Harm against beings obstructs the accomplishment of a mantra.
items.inference: Therefore, even extensively recited, the mantra does not succeed for such a person.
uncertainties: The exact referent of tasya relies on the preceding context of one who causes harm.
items.plain_english: Even if recited a hundred lakhs of times, his mantra does not succeed.
